messages:
zoe: Quick sync 1: we need a tight copy pass for three launch pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Must drive webinar signups, capture demo leads, and ensure form routing doesn't leak enterprise leads to self-serve. Mobile-first.
maria: Core constraints: one-line hero, three short benefit bullets, one micro-benchmark line per page, primary CTA = Register Webinar, clear enterprise path to Request Quote. Keep language active and scannable.
ashley: Draft hero variants (short): A) 'Same developer experience. Multiple deployment footprints.' B) 'Ship LLM features reliably 1: hosted, reserved, or private.' Which feels fresher?
kevin: I like A for dev focus. For benchmarks, keep them human: Hosted ~45 ms median token latency (small open model); Dedicated ~6k tokens/sec sustained on reserved pools; Private = audit logs + customer KMS + optional air-gapped install. Round numbers.
maria: Good. Benefit bullets (one line each): 1) Unified REST & SDK surface across modes 2) Predictable unit economics + autoscaling controls 3) Enterprise controls: VPC, KMS, audit trails.
ashley: CTA text proposals: 1) 'Register: Live demo + benchmark walkthrough' 2) 'See it live: webinar + Q&A' 3) 'Request a quote' (enterprise only). We'll use 1 as primary, 3 as primary on Dedicated/Private for enterprise nudges.
kevin: Short ops-friendly routing snippet to hand to eng (pseudocode):
```
on_submit(form):
  if form.company_size == 'enterprise' or form.request_quote:
    send_to('sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai')
    tag('enterprise')
  elif form.wants_dedicated:
    send_to('solutions@redwood.ai')
    tag('dedicated-interest')
  elif form.action == 'register_webinar':
    send_to('marketing-webinars@redwood.ai')
    tag('webinar')
  else:
    send_to('selfserve@redwood.ai')
```
maria: Add a short hidden field for primary_use_case (picklist) so SDRs can prioritize. Also ensure utm_campaign is captured and passed to the CRM.
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar landing page must be live Tue 09:00 PT. Ashley finalize CTAs by Mon 17:00 PT. Also enable captcha + webhook retries.
ashley: I'll upload hero A/B and the three CTA variants to the Website Copy doc and tag for quick review. Will add micro-benchmark copy with links to short PDFs.
kevin: I'll produce three one-page benchmark PDFs (methodology, rig, prompts, model families, quant notes) and post links here. On-site micro-benchmark lines will link to those PDFs with 'see methodology'.
maria: Final sign-off meeting Mon 10:00 PT. If engineering needs clarifications on routing fields or payloads, tag @kevin and @maria. Let's keep copy tight. :rocket:
